content: Apple is laying off staff on the Siri and the Vision Pro teams, according to Bloomberg. The cuts include “largely shutting down” a Vision Pro gaming team and “reducing the size” of the team that makes Vision Pro immersive content, the publication says. More than 200 jobs were cut. Apple said in a statement to Bloomberg it was making the changes to “to evolve our business to deliver the best experiences for our users,” though it will be making new roles. The company didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment from The Verge. The Vision Pro launched in early 2024 as Apple’s big bet on “spatial computing,” but the $3,499 headset doesn’t appear to have been a big hit. While Bloomberg reported in May that Apple is working on “a slimmer and lighter headset” to succeed the current Vision Pro (which was updated last year with an M5 chip), a report a few weeks after said that Apple was suspending work with Samsung Display on a display for an entry-level XR machine. However, following the success of Meta’s smart glasses, Apple is apparently planning to make its own smart glasses, with Bloomberg reporting recently that Apple plans to announce them at WWDC (typically a June event) in 2027 and launch them by the end of that year. The company finally launched its revamped, AI-powered Siri at this year’s WWDC. The new Siri is set to be available to the public in beta later this year.
chineseTitle: 苹果正在裁员 Vision Pro 和 Siri 的员工

chineseContent: 据彭博社报道，苹果正在裁员 Siri 和 Vision Pro 团队的员工。该出版物称，裁员包括“很大程度上关闭”Vision Pro 游戏团队，以及“缩小”制作 Vision Pro 沉浸式内容的团队规模。超过200个工作岗位被裁减。苹果在给彭博社的一份声明中表示，它正在做出改变，以“发展我们的业务，为我们的用户提供最好的体验”，尽管它将任命新的角色。该公司没有立即回复 The Verge 的置评请求。 Vision Pro 于 2024 年初推出，是苹果在“空间计算”上的一大赌注，但这款售价 3,499 美元的耳机似乎并没有大受欢迎。虽然彭博社 5 月份报道称，苹果正在开发“一款更轻薄的耳机”，以接替当前的 Vision Pro（去年更新了 M5 芯片），但几周后的一篇报道称，苹果将暂停与三星 Display 合作开发入门级 XR 机器的显示屏。然而，随着 Meta 智能眼镜的成功，苹果显然正计划制造自己的智能眼镜，彭博社最近报道称，苹果计划在 2027 年的 WWDC（通常是 6 月的活动）上宣布这款智能眼镜，并在年底前推出。该公司终于在今年的 WWDC 上推出了经过改进的人工智能 Siri。新的 Siri 将于今年晚些时候向公众推出测试版。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
